scope: Current-source production compiler artifacts: capability fast path is present in both; candidate changes only prelude graph encoding and its reader. The bundler uses quoted literals for carriage-return bytes to preserve the compact binary image. Sizes are measured bytes, not network or startup times.

validation.sameGraph: All eight roots, table fields, metatables, interning arenas and counters retained; dictionary/varints replace repeated strings and decimal integer encodings. Source and image re-encode byte-identically under each interpreter.
validation.codecTests: Binary strings, nil/booleans, signed integers through2^53-1, fractional values, negativezero, infinities, NaN, cycles/tablekeys, live-intern preservation and malformed data rejection.
